title: de la Vallée Poussin Means of Walsh-Fourier Expansions
summary: We study de la Vallée Poussin means of Walsh--Fourier series associated with a nondecreasing window sequence. We establish a sharp criterion for almost everywhere convergence for integrable functions. We further show that, when this criterion fails, every Orlicz class below the logarithmic square-root scale contains a function whose de la Vallée Poussin means diverge everywhere.
